items.title: Why you SHOULDN'T become an AI Engineer
He Wrote a Long Reply to an AI Email
items.summary: In episode 1033 of the SuperDataScience podcast, @JonKrohnLearns discusses with Prof. Jeff Hancock, Stanford University, how he found himself writing a lengthy, thoughtful reply to an AI-generated email, realizing he was style-matching with a machine. This highlights the concept of linguistic reciprocity and how humans unconsciously adapt their communication style to others, even to AI. It raises interesting questions about our interactions with artificial intelligence.

items.title: Google's GPT-3 Moment for Databases & Spreadsheets (TabFM)
items.summary: Thanks to Neon for sponsoring this video. Check out Neon for your backend needs for your apps and agents: https://neon.plug.dev/zzzGgpR Google Research's TabFM is a zero-shot foundation model for tabular data: you pass it the rows you already know, and it predicts the rest in a single forward pass, with no training. In this video I explain how TabFM learns from synthetic tables, why it can't read column names, and how TabFM-Auto adds an LLM agent around it. Then I build that agent on Neon Postgres to predict customer churn, and show how a leaky column fooled the agent and how a branch of the database's history fixed it. Neon: https://neon.plug.dev/zzzGgpR TabFM blog post: https://research.google/blog/introducing-tabfm-a-zero-shot-foundation-model-for-tabular-data/ TabFM paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37959 TabFM-Auto paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37989 TabFM on GitHub: https://github.com/google-research/tabfm TabFM on Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/google/tabfm-1.1.0-pytorch

items.title: AI Coding Is a Slot Machine: Loss Disguised as a Win | Jeremy Howard
items.summary: Jeremy Howard, co-founder of fast.ai, on why AI-assisted coding works like a slot machine: you craft the prompt, pull the lever, and the occasional win feels like control. In his words: "It's got all these hallmarks of loss disguised as a win... all the stuff that gaming companies try to engineer into their gaming rooms." Full conversation with Jeremy on Machine Learning Street Talk. #Shorts #AICoding #MachineLearning Watch the full conversation: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dHBEQ-Ryo24
